guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice shows the largest anomaly (latency-50 +859%, z=+171.75) and is the only service with disk I/O going from 0 to ~4023 (z=+20), while downstream callers (checkoutservice, frontend) degrade as its callers. Socket (+49%) and CPU (+47%) also rose, which could be secondary effects of the disk I/O stall or an alternative fault, but disk I/O is the sharpest resource signal; logs have no errors and the traces show no error spans, so there is no direct confirmation.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate the currencyservice pod's disk I/O (identify the process or volume producing writes), then move it to a healthy node or restart the pod if the I/O source is confirmed to be fault-induced. Verify latency recovers.
